title: Galerkin Approximation of the Fractional Sobolev Constant
summary: We establish sharp estimates for the discrete optimal constant of the fractional Sobolev inequality in dimension $N\geq 1$, with fractional exponent $s\in (0,\min\{1,N/2\})$. The convergence rates that we establish take place for the Galerkin approximation with piecewise linear elements, when the problem is posed in the unit ball, for which we employ a quasi-uniform and regular mesh.
